```{r}
#| include: false
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) {
  CAP <- stats::setNames(
    lapply(
      c("inventory", "lt", "recurrence", "depth"),
      function(key) readCaption(sprintf("tbl.SSM.IND.%s", key))
    ),
    c("inventory", "lt", "recurrence", "depth")
  )
}
```

&nbsp;

```{r}
#| label: tbl-ssm-ind-inventory
#| tbl-cap: !expr CAP$inventory

DT <- data.table::data.table(
  TRT   = c("SIS", "SIF", "SCC", "ASC", "Total"),
  Area  = c(35L, 27L, 17L, 29L, 108L),
  Point = c(139942L, 123748L, 94433L, 84966L, 443089L),
  Total = c(139977L, 123775L, 94450L, 84995L, 443197L)
)

TBL <- DT |> buildTable(
  library = "flextable",
  align.body = "center",
  font.size.body = FONT.SIZE.BODY,
  font.size.header = FONT.SIZE.HEADER
) |>
  flextable::set_table_properties(layout = "autofit")
TBL <- flextable::align(TBL, j = c("Area", "Point", "Total"), align = "right", part = "body")
TBL
```

DT <- data.table::data.table(
  `Set` = c(1L, 2L, 3L),
  `Parameter` = c("Source model", "Mmax", "b"),
  `Branches (value, weight)` = c(
    "b1m1 areal model (0.40); b1m2 smoothed grid, threshold 4.5 (0.27); b1m3 smoothed grid, threshold 5.5 (0.33)",
    "-0.3 (0.32); 0.0 (0.36); +0.3 (0.32)",
    "-0.1 (0.32); 0.0 (0.36); +0.1 (0.32)"
  )
)

TBL <- DT |> buildTable(
  library = "flextable",
  align.body = "center",
  font.size.body = FONT.SIZE.BODY,
  font.size.header = FONT.SIZE.HEADER
) |>
  flextable::set_table_properties(layout = "autofit")
TBL

```{r}
#| label: tbl-ssm-ind-recurrence
#| tbl-cap: !expr CAP$recurrence

DT <- data.table::data.table(
  TRT   = c("ASC", "SCC", "SIF", "SIS"),
  MFD   = c("truncGR", "truncGR", "truncGR", "truncGR"),
  a     = c("2.73–7.08", "1.58–4.84", "3.12–5.40", "3.22–7.33"),
  b     = c("0.72–1.37", "0.63–1.19", "0.72–1.24", "0.80–1.57"),
  Mmin  = c("4.5", "4.5", "4.5", "4.5–7.5"),
  Mmax  = c("7.0–8.8", "6.0–8.2", "6.5–9.4", "6.5–8.6"),
  Low   = c("6.7–8.5", "5.7–7.9", "6.2–9.1", "6.2–8.3"),
  High  = c("7.3–9.1", "6.3–8.5", "6.8–9.7", "6.8–8.9"),
  N     = c(29L, 17L, 27L, 35L)
)

TBL <- DT |> buildTable(
  library = "flextable",
  align.body = "center",
  font.size.body = FONT.SIZE.BODY,
  font.size.header = FONT.SIZE.HEADER
) |>
  .mathHeader(c(a = "a", b = "b", Mmin = "M_{min}", Mmax = "M_{max}", N = "N")) |>
  flextable::set_table_properties(layout = "autofit")
TBL <- flextable::align(TBL, j = "N", align = "right", part = "body")
TBL
```

#| label: tbl-ssm-ind-depth
#| tbl-cap: !expr CAP$depth

DT <- data.table::data.table(
  TRT = c("ASC", "SCC", "SIF", "SIS"),
  `z_upper (km)` = c("0", "0–25", "0–70", "25–180"),
  `z_lower (km)` = c("25", "25–70", "25–180", "70–300"),
  `Mean hypocentral depth (km)` = c("15", "15–25", "15–70", "25–180")
)

TBL <- DT |> buildTable(
  library = "flextable",
  align.body = "center",
  font.size.body = FONT.SIZE.BODY,
  font.size.header = FONT.SIZE.HEADER
) |>
  flextable::set_table_properties(layout = "autofit")
TBL
